question: Does computing the FP16 target lm_head in <=32-row chunks (proven row-invariant and equal to single-row arithmetic at the operator level) remove the remaining c32/c64 identity misses on the row-invariant R139 image, alone or together with the 2048-token batch budget tested by R148?

evidence_base.operator_probe: experiments/qwen38-27b-b70/data/2026-09-02-qwen38-fp16-lm-head-chunk-invariance-probe-result.json: F.linear(K=5120,N=124160) rows 1-32 are one exact class; 32-row chunking equals M=1 rows bit for bit at every M<=256 including permutations; repeat-exact
evidence_base.ladders: R147b (MTP1) and R147c (MTP0): exact through c16, 30/32 at c32, 58/64 at c64

treatment.mechanism: LogitsProcessor._apply_head splits hidden rows into VLLM_XPU_LM_HEAD_CHUNK_ROWS-row calls to the unchanged quant_method.apply and concatenates; default 0 (off); XPU only; marker 'R149 lm_head chunked apply executed' when rows exceed the chunk

arms.ladder-mtp1-chunk32-2048: R62-treatment MTP1 on R149, chunk 32, max_num_batched_tokens 2048 (the arm expected to pass if R148 shows the budget matters and the head is the second source)
arms.conditional: if R148 already passes both ladders at 2048 without chunking, R149 runs only ladder-mtp1-chunk32-512 as an information arm and the head chunk is not adopted (single variable rule)

gates.G6_chunk: every complete concurrent output at c1..c64 equals its sequential oracle, harness exit 0, per profile
gates.c1_unchanged: the ladder's own 64 sequential oracles must equal the R147b/R147c sequential oracles (chunking must not change c1 output; at c1 rows<=32 the chunk path is a no-op by construction)
gates.marker: 'R149 lm_head chunked apply executed' present in the server log on both ranks for c64

performance_recording.note: chunking adds one extra lm_head weight pass per 32 rows above 32; record c64 aggregate versus R147b/R147c

on_pass: R139+R149 with chunk 32 (and the batch budget from R148) is the identity-qualified concurrency configuration; run the strict single-user suite on it once to confirm c1 speed is unchanged, then present the publication text
on_failure: record the residual mismatches; the next census target is the GDN and attention kernels at batch >= 32
